item.title: SolidRun and Leopard Imaging team on Edge AI vision
item.summary: SolidRun and Leopard Imaging have teamed up to simplify the development of edge AI vision systems, combining camera modules from Leopard Imaging with SolidRun’s Hailo-15-based embedded AI platforms. The companies say the collaboration is designed to reduce camera integration work and help developers move faster from evaluation to production.
